articles.headline: World Cup LIVE: Socceroos, Türkiye engaged in tense battle
articles.description: With Group D wide open after the USMNT's 4-1 win over Paraguay, can Australia or Türkiye take the initiative? Follow all the action LIVE with ESPN.

articles.headline: Scotland ease 'pressure' with 1st World Cup win since 1990
articles.description: Steve Clarke said his Scotland side's long-awaited World Cup win over Haiti means the team have less pressure on them as they prepare to face Morocco.

articles.headline: Irankunda scores to give the Socceroos the lead over Türkiye
articles.description: Nestory Irankunda shows some serious pace and slots the ball in the bottom left corner to take the lead over Türkiye.

articles.headline: Scotland goes top of Group C with 1-0 win over Haiti
articles.description: John McGinn was the hero for Scotland as his strike was the difference in their first World Cup win since 1990.

articles.headline: 2 Texas men charged after England World Cup gear stolen
articles.description: Two men have been charged with one felony count each of receiving stolen property late Saturday after England's national team discovered that some of their equipment had been stolen.

articles.headline: Scotland make 28-year World Cup drought worth the wait on winning return
articles.description: The Scottish party in Boston won't be finishing anytime soon as Scotland took one step towards the World Cup knockout stages by defeating Haiti 1-0 in Foxborough.
